definitions.gloss: relative; relation; kin; someone to depend on
definitions.explanation: A person one can rely on, especially a family member or close relative. Most commonly used in negative expressions to describe someone who has no relatives or no one to turn to.

examples.japanese: {身寄|みよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of elderly people with no relatives is increasing.
I have not a single relative in this town.

examples.japanese: {身寄|みよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A facility was established for children with no family to rely on.

notes:
USAGE:
{身寄|みよ}り is most commonly used in the pattern {身寄|みよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without relatives, without anyone to depend on). It is rarely used in positive contexts like "having many relatives."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身寄|みよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person without relatives)
- {身寄|みよ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no relatives)
- {身寄|みよ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (to rely on a relative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧ is the general word for relatives and is used in neutral or positive contexts. {身寄|みよ}り specifically implies someone one can depend on and is typically used when describing the absence of such support.
